{{Quote|They are a vile sort. Roric V`lia, Noble of the Naboo family, whom is my employer, doesn't like to deal with them much. But, I guess--uh. I wasn't suppose to tell you that.|[[Vaik'anna Silverlight]], about the [[Maulers]]|<ref name="SWG:VS" />}}
'''Roric V`lia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he employed the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vaik'anna Silverlight]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] for different activities related to the [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility]], the [[Maulers]] criminals and the [[Imperial vs. Gungan Battle|war between the Empire and the Gungans]]. Silverlight considered Roric V`lia as a ruthless man.<ref name="SWG:VS" />
